title: 第17章 宫中晚宴第18章 刺杀再现
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 这是萧风来到这个世界后，首次来到凤仪宫。
当他进来之后，不禁眼前一亮，不愧是皇后的寝宫，建筑气势恢宏，各种亭台楼阁错落有致地分布着，每一处都精心雕琢，借着灯光和月光，整个布局美轮美奂。

当萧风踏入缓步踏入主殿之时，发现其他的贵妃们和皇子都已经落座了，还有几位公主，但是萧风是没有任何印象的。萧鼎锋坐在主位上，看着进来的萧风，他面带微笑，直接向萧风招手，示意他坐到自己身边来。这一举动，一石激起千层浪，众人的脸色一下就不自然起来，似乎对萧鼎锋如此厚待萧风感到诧异，心里对萧风又多了几分忌惮，虽然现在他们感觉不到萧风有修为，但是他可是皇子啊，不可能不能修炼，虽说过来最佳的修炼时机，但却不是不能修炼的，况且现在又和丞相府联姻，这个可是在夺嫡路上又多了一个竞争对手。
然而，面对众人复杂多变的神情，萧风却像是看不到一般，没有丝毫的犹豫，直接走向了萧鼎锋，然后落落大方地坐在他旁边的座位上。
萧风落座之后，萧鼎锋面带微笑地环视一圈，然后开口道：“今天是咱们自家家宴，没有外人，大家都不要太拘束，放松一些。这些次的家宴，一来是庆祝老七正式开府立户，二来，则是欢迎老三戍边归来。老三，从今往后，你便留在京城吧，暂时不用回边境去了。”
萧鼎锋一边说，一边微笑的环视着众人，萧晨和他母妃都是面露喜色，其他人也是一脸的高兴，当然心里怎么想就不知道了，二皇子萧鸿，眼里一丝阴冷的看着萧风，心里想着，你给我等着，下次必杀你。当然这种眼神是有一瞬，大家都没有发现。
只见萧鼎锋还是面带微笑的举起手中的酒杯，向在座的众人示意道：“来，咱们共同干一杯！”说罢，他仰头一饮而尽。其他人见状，也是纷纷举起酒杯回应，一时间觥光交错之声不绝于耳。等众人共饮一杯之后，萧鼎锋放下酒杯，笑着说道：“好了，大家都是一家人，不必拘束，用膳吧。”
然而，尽管萧鼎锋已经如此说了，但是在场的众人，还是不太敢，彼此之间也不太交流。当然众人之中只有一人例外，那就是萧风。
萧风仿佛周围没有任何人，只顾着低头猛吃眼前丰盛的菜肴，其实也不怪萧风，他本来也都不认识这些人，没什么要寒暄的，至于萧鼎锋，他也不会怪罪自己，自己就一直低头干饭，来的这个世界，还没有好好的吃一顿，之前晚上不是在修炼，就是为了引出刺杀，只能吃普通的酒楼，这下可是给了自己机会，想着，之后一定要去尝尝这个世界的美食，毕竟自己在上辈子就是个爱吃的人。
萧鼎锋静静看着埋头干饭的萧风，嘴角不自觉的上扬，流露出一抹深深的溺爱之色。不知为何，最近看到萧风，脑海中便会不由自主地浮现出白飞雪那绝美的容颜和温柔的笑容。仿佛在萧风的身上，能够寻找到白飞雪曾经留下的丝丝缕缕的痕迹。
而坐在一旁的皇后，自然也没有错过萧鼎锋这细微的表情变化，她微微眯起双眸，顺着萧鼎锋的视线一通望去，落在了萧风那张和陛下十分相似的脸庞上。不看不知道，一看之下，皇后心中猛地一惊，这萧风不愧是白飞雪的儿子，真的身上有她的影子，特别是那双眼睛，虽然都说萧风像陛下，但是那双眼睛完全就是白飞雪的，像一个模子里刻出来一样。
想到这里，皇后的脸色瞬间阴沉下来，原本温柔端庄的面容被一股冰冷的恨意所取代。她紧紧握着手中的手帕，关节因用力过度而微微泛白。
然而就在这时，正在专心干饭的萧风突然感觉到有什么东西在盯着他，弄的他很不舒服，随即便抬起头来找寻那道目光。
可是当他凭借着敏锐的感知力向刚才的方向看去时，却突然发现那道阴冷的目光消失了，只有一脸慈爱、笑意盈盈的萧鼎锋以及身旁同样面带微笑的皇后。难道是自己感觉错了？不可能啊，那种阴冷的充满怨毒的寒意是绝对不会错的。
可如果不是他们，又会是谁呢？难不成是皇后？但是皇后此时和蔼可亲的模样，萧风实在是无法将那道阴冷的目光与皇后联系在一起。

观察萧风的绝对不止一个皇后，众人几乎都在观察他，因为其他人他们都很了解，但是唯独萧风，他们是一点都不知道，只知道是白飞雪的儿子，但是因为陛下不允许讨论白飞雪，所以他们也早就忘了这个人，直到前一阵听轩小筑失火，萧风才再次走进人们的视野中，再加上火速封王开府，以及和丞相府联姻，让他们不得不重新审视这个从来不受重视的皇子，为何摇身一变成为了炙手可热的皇子，虽然现在还没有实际的权利和势力，但是背后是丞相府，这可不是一般皇子能做到的。
萧鼎锋也发现众人都在偷偷的观察萧风，也是没有说是什么。
这时大皇子萧凯举着酒杯来到了萧风面前，说道：“七弟，恭喜你封王开府，还希望七弟以后能好好为旭日王朝出力，同时也为父皇分忧啊。”
对于萧凯的举动，萧鼎锋很欣赏，嫡出长子，本应是能直接夺得东宫之位的，但是，他背后的世家虽是他的助力，但也是他的弱点啊。
萧风也是站起身来：“大哥，客气了，为王朝出力是我们每个皇子应该做的，为父王分忧也是应该的。”随后两人都一饮而尽。
其他皇子也是纷纷的向萧风走来，都是说了些客套话，大家都心知肚明。
这时六皇子萧云也是来到了萧风面前，说道：“七弟，为兄也是没有什么好送你的，我在西街有两个小门面，就送给你，当是恭祝你开府的贺礼吧。”
“这，可使不得，六哥，你还是收回去吧。”
“没事，反正在我手里也没啥用，就送给七弟你吧，没事你不要有负担，几位哥哥也都是有的。”
萧风听着萧云这样说，没办法只能是收下了。本来是想买几个铺子，这直接就有现成的了。
萧鼎锋看着众人客套完之后，直接宣布这次的家宴结束，众人也是都各自散去，本来有几个公主想来和萧风说几句话，但是萧风却借着酒劲遁走了。

content_en:
This is the first time Xiao Feng has come to Fengyi Palace since he came to this world.
When he came in, his eyes lit up. It was indeed the queen's palace. The building was magnificent, with various pavilions and pavilions scattered in an orderly manner. Each part was carefully carved. With the light and moonlight, the whole layout was beautiful.
When Xiao Feng walked slowly into the main hall, he found that the other concubines and princes had already taken their seats, as well as several princesses, but Xiao Feng had no impression of them. Xiao Dingfeng sat in the main seat and looked at Xiao Feng who came in. He smiled and waved directly to Xiao Feng, gesturing for him to sit next to him. This move stirred up a thousand waves with one stone, and everyone's expressions suddenly changed. They seemed to be surprised that Xiao Dingfeng treated Xiao Feng so favorably, and they were a little more wary of Xiao Feng. Although they could not feel that Xiao Feng had any cultivation ability now, he was a prince, so it was impossible that he could not practice. Although it was the best time to practice in the past, it was not impossible for him to practice. Moreover, he was now married to the Prime Minister's Mansion, which gave him another competitor on the road to seize the throne.
However, facing the complicated and changeable expressions of everyone, Xiao Feng seemed to be unable to see it. Without any hesitation, he walked directly to Xiao Dingfeng and sat down on the seat next to him gracefully.
After Xiao Feng sat down, Xiao Dingfeng looked around with a smile, and then said: "Today is our family banquet, there are no outsiders, everyone should not be too restrained and relax. These family banquets are, firstly, to celebrate the official opening of the house by the seventh child, and secondly, to welcome the third child back from guarding the border. Third child, from now on, you will stay in the capital and there is no need to go back to the border for the time being."
As Xiao Dingfeng spoke, he looked around at everyone with a smile. Xiao Chen and his mother and concubine both looked happy, and everyone else also looked happy. Of course, I don't know what they were thinking. The second prince, Xiao Hong, looked at Xiao Feng with a cold look in his eyes, thinking to himself, just wait for me, I will kill you next time. Of course, this look lasted for a moment, and no one noticed it.
Xiao Dingfeng still smiled and raised the wine glass in his hand, signaling to everyone present: "Come, let's have a drink together!" After that, he raised his head and drank it all. Seeing this, other people also raised their wine glasses in response, and for a while the sound of glasses and glasses could be heard. After everyone had a drink together, Xiao Dingfeng put down his wine glass and said with a smile: "Okay, we are all a family, there is no need to be restrained, let's have a meal."
However, even though Xiao Dingfeng had said so, everyone present still didn't dare and didn't communicate much with each other. Of course, there is only one exception among everyone, and that is Xiao Feng.
Xiao Feng seemed to have no one around him. He just lowered his head and ate the sumptuous dishes in front of him. In fact, he didn’t blame Xiao Feng. He didn’t know these people and had nothing to say. As for Xiao Dingfeng, he would not blame himself. He had always lowered his head to eat. In this world, World, I haven't had a good meal yet. I was either practicing or leading out an assassination at night, so I could only eat ordinary restaurants. This time I gave myself a chance, thinking that I must try the food of this world in the future. After all, I was a food lover in my previous life.
Xiao Dingfeng quietly looked at Xiao Feng who was immersed in cooking, and the corners of his mouth unconsciously raised, revealing a look of deep doting. For some reason, when I saw Xiao Feng recently, I couldn't help but think of Bai Feixue's beautiful face and gentle smile. It seems that in Xiao Feng's body, every trace of Bai Feixue's past can be found.
The queen sitting aside naturally did not miss the subtle change in Xiao Dingfeng's expression. She narrowed her eyes slightly, followed Xiao Dingfeng's line of sight, and landed on Xiao Feng's face that was very similar to His Majesty's. She didn't know it, but at first glance, the queen was shocked. This Xiao Feng was indeed Bai Feixue's son. He really had her shadow on him, especially those eyes. Although Xiao Feng was said to resemble His Majesty, those eyes were completely Bai Feixue's, as if they were carved from the same mold.
Thinking of this, the queen's face instantly darkened, and her original gentle and dignified face was replaced by a cold hatred. She held the handkerchief in her hand tightly, her joints turning slightly white from excessive exertion.
However, at this moment, Xiao Feng, who was concentrating on cooking, suddenly felt something staring at him, which made him very uncomfortable, and then he raised his head to look for that gaze.
But when he looked in the direction just now with his keen perception, he suddenly found that the cold gaze disappeared, leaving only Xiao Dingfeng with a loving and smiling face and the Queen beside him who was also smiling. Could it be that I felt wrong? Impossible, that cold and spiteful chill is absolutely unmistakable.
But if not them, who would it be? Could it be the queen? But with the Queen's amiable appearance at this time, Xiao Feng really couldn't associate that cold gaze with the Queen.
There was definitely more than one queen observing Xiao Feng. Almost everyone was observing him, because they knew everyone else well, but they knew nothing about Xiao Feng. They only knew that he was Bai Feixue's son, but because His Majesty did not allow discussion of Bai Feixue, they had long forgotten about this person. It was not until the fire broke out in Tingxuan Xiaozhu a while ago that Xiao Feng Entering people's field of vision again, coupled with the rapid appointment of the king and the establishment of a palace, and the marriage with the Prime Minister's Palace, they had to re-examine why this prince who had never been taken seriously suddenly turned into a hot prince. Although he did not have actual rights and power now, the Prime Minister's Palace was behind him. This was not something that ordinary princes could do.
Xiao Dingfeng also found that everyone was secretly observing Xiao Feng without saying what they were doing.
At this time, the eldest prince Xiao Kai came to Xiao Feng with a wine glass and said: "Seventh brother, congratulations on your appointment as king and opening a palace. I also hope that seventh brother can contribute to the Rising Sun Dynasty in the future, and at the same time share the worries of my father."
Xiao Dingfeng admired Xiao Kai's actions very much. The eldest son should have been able to directly win the position of the East Palace. However, although the family behind him was his help, it was also his weakness.
Xiao Feng also stood up: "Brother, you're welcome. It is what each of our princes should do to contribute to the dynasty, and it is also what we should do to share the worries of our father." Then both of them drank.
The other princes also came towards Xiao Feng one after another, and they all said some polite words, which everyone knew well.
At this time, the sixth prince Xiao Yun also came to Xiao Feng and said: "Seventh brother, I don't have anything to give you. I have two small storefronts on West Street, so I will give them to you as a gift to congratulate you on opening your mansion."
"This can't be done, Sixth Brother, you'd better take it back."
"It's okay. It's of no use in my hands anyway. I'll just give it to you, my seventh brother. It's okay. Don't be burdened with it. Several brothers have it too."
When Xiao Feng heard what Xiao Yun said, he had no choice but to accept it. Originally, I wanted to buy a few shops, but I already had them readily available.
After Xiao Dingfeng watched everyone finish their polite greetings, he directly announced that the family banquet was over, and everyone dispersed. Several princesses originally wanted to come and say a few words to Xiao Feng, but Xiao Feng escaped with the strength of his wine.
